parameters.content:
import hashlib
import json
import re

PAIR_KJ_PER_EH = 2625.4996394799


def read_text(path):
    with open(path, "r", errors="replace") as handle:
        return handle.read()


def sha256_of(path):
    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
        return hashlib.sha256(handle.read()).hexdigest()


def final_energy(text, label):
    matches = re.findall(r"FINAL SINGLE POINT ENERGY\s+(-?\d+\.\d+)", text)
    if not matches:
        raise RuntimeError("no FINAL SINGLE POINT ENERGY line in " + label)
    if "ORCA TERMINATED NORMALLY" not in text:
        raise RuntimeError("ORCA did not terminate normally: " + label)
    return float(matches[-1])


gas_inp = read_text("gas_job.inp")
cpcm_inp = read_text("cpcm_job.inp")
gas_out = read_text("gas_stdout.out")
cpcm_out = read_text("cpcm_stdout.out")

if "CPCM" not in cpcm_inp.upper():
    raise RuntimeError("C-PCM water keyword missing from the aqueous input")
if "CPCM" in gas_inp.upper():
    raise RuntimeError("solvent declaration found in the gas-phase input")

e_gas = final_energy(gas_out, "gas phase")
e_cpcm = final_energy(cpcm_out, "C-PCM water")
delta_kj = (e_cpcm - e_gas) * PAIR_KJ_PER_EH

xyz_sha = sha256_of("ethanol.xyz")
gas_inp_sha = sha256_of("gas_job.inp")
cpcm_inp_sha = sha256_of("cpcm_job.inp")
gas_out_sha = sha256_of("gas_stdout.out")
cpcm_out_sha = sha256_of("cpcm_stdout.out")

report = (
    "Same fixed initial geometry (prepared ethanol, neutral singlet) used for both "
    "single-point electronic-energy calculations; neither geometry was reoptimized. "
    "Method B3LYP and basis def2-TZVP chosen identically for the gas-phase and the "
    "ORCA C-PCM water runs; %maxcore 192 per process; scf MaxIter 256 with AutoTRAH "
    "false; NoAutoStart set in both inputs. Gas phase uses no solvent declaration; the "
    "aqueous run uses CPCM(water). Sigma = sign of E(C-PCM water) - E(gas phase). "
    "Limitations: electronic energies only for the specified model; no zero-point, "
    "thermal, entropic or standard-state corrections; the difference is not a full "
    "hydration free energy. Only the final single-point energies are reported, and "
    "neither input geometry was independently verified beyond the supplied XYZ."
)

observations = [
    {
        "name": "energy_gas",
        "value": e_gas,
        "unit": "Eh",
        "sources": [
            {"filename": "gas_stdout.out", "location": "FINAL SINGLE POINT ENERGY line"}
        ],
        "formula": None,
        "artifacts": ["gas_stdout.out"],
        "limitations": [
            "Gas-phase single-point electronic energy at the fixed input geometry.",
            "No thermal, zero-point, entropic or standard-state corrections included.",
        ],
    },
    {
        "name": "energy_cpcm_water",
        "value": e_cpcm,
        "unit": "Eh",
        "sources": [
            {"filename": "cpcm_stdout.out", "location": "FINAL SINGLE POINT ENERGY line"}
        ],
        "formula": None,
        "artifacts": ["cpcm_stdout.out"],
        "limitations": [
            "Single-point electronic energy in the ORCA C-PCM water model at the same fixed geometry.",
            "Implicit-solvent model only; no explicit waters, no thermal or standard-state corrections.",
        ],
    },
    {
        "name": "energy_difference",
        "value": delta_kj,
        "unit": "kJ/mol",
        "sources": [
            {"filename": "gas_stdout.out", "location": "FINAL SINGLE POINT ENERGY line"},
            {"filename": "cpcm_stdout.out", "location": "FINAL SINGLE POINT ENERGY line"},
        ],
        "formula": (
            "deltaE = E(C-PCM water) - E(gas phase), both from the same fixed geometry; "
            "converted with 1 Eh = 2625.4996394799 kJ/mol"
        ),
        "artifacts": ["gas_stdout.out", "cpcm_stdout.out"],
        "limitations": [
            "Specified-model electronic-energy difference only; not a complete hydration free energy.",
            "No zero-point, thermal, entropic or standard-state corrections were applied.",
            "A negative value means the C-PCM water electronic energy lies below the gas-phase value.",
        ],
    },
    {
        "name": "raw_input_output",
        "value": {
            "ethanol.xyz": xyz_sha,
            "gas_job.inp": gas_inp_sha,
            "cpcm_job.inp": cpcm_inp_sha,
            "gas_stdout.out": gas_out_sha,
            "cpcm_stdout.out": cpcm_out_sha,
        },
        "unit": None,
        "sources": [
            {"filename": "gas_job.inp", "location": None},
            {"filename": "cpcm_job.inp", "location": None},
            {"filename": "gas_stdout.out", "location": None},
            {"filename": "cpcm_stdout.out", "location": None},
        ],
        "formula": None,
        "artifacts": [
            "ethanol.xyz",
            "gas_job.inp",
            "cpcm_job.inp",
            "gas_stdout.out",
            "cpcm_stdout.out",
        ],
        "limitations": [
            "Entries are SHA-256 digests of the archived task copies of the shared XYZ, the two raw ORCA inputs and the two raw ORCA outputs.",
            "Digests identify the archived copies and do not by themselves validate the scientific content.",
        ],
    },
    {
        "name": "report",
        "value": report,
        "unit": None,
        "sources": [
            {"filename": "gas_job.inp", "location": None},
            {"filename": "cpcm_job.inp", "location": None},
            {"filename": "gas_stdout.out", "location": None},
            {"filename": "cpcm_stdout.out", "location": None},
        ],
        "formula": None,
        "artifacts": ["gas_job.inp", "cpcm_job.inp"],
        "limitations": [
            "Statements cover the solvent model, settings and the limits of the reported quantity, as recorded in the archived inputs and outputs.",
        ],
    },
    {
        "name": "random_seed",
        "value": 1701,
        "unit": None,
        "sources": [{"filename": "gas_job.inp", "location": None}],
        "formula": None,
        "artifacts": [],
        "limitations": [
            "Seed 1701 is recorded as requested; the two single-point energy evaluations and the parsing step use no random-number generator.",
            "Whether the upstream structure preparation used a stochastic search that accepts a seed is not established by these outputs.",
        ],
    },
]

with open("observations.json", "w") as handle:
    json.dump({"version": 1, "observations": observations}, handle, indent=2)

print(json.dumps({
    "energy_gas_Eh": e_gas,
    "energy_cpcm_water_Eh": e_cpcm,
    "delta_kJ_per_mol": delta_kj,
    "xyz_sha256": xyz_sha,
}, indent=2))
